_meta.name: MECHANISM_VITAMIN_K_CARBOXYLATION_evidence
_meta.script: vitk_model.py -- 6-factor 1-compartment-per-factor PD model, closed-form + independent scipy.integrate.solve_ivp cross-check; executed this session in scratch workspace, not committed into bodytwin (deliverables are this .json + the paired .md only, per task scope) -- every number reproducible directly from the closed-form formulas quoted in the .md Sec.3/Sec.6

claim: A 6-factor (II,VII,IX,X,protein C,protein S) 1-compartment-per-factor pharmacodynamic model, using each factor's own clearance half-life as its ODE eigenvalue, reproduces (a) the measured multi-day warfarin INR-onset delay (1.9d idealized / 5.1d realistic-titrated vs task's stated 3-5d and StatPearls' 5-7d peak), forcing the task-named 'instantaneous warfarin' adversary to fail outright; (b) a transient net-procoagulant hypercoagulable window (peak day 0.90, within the clinically-documented first-week skin-necrosis timing) that is DISSOCIATED from a simultaneously-elevated early-INR signal (2.87) -- the quantitative mechanism behind warfarin-induced skin necrosis; and (c) is PROVABLY impossible (exact algebraic zero, not measured-small) under a forced uniform-half-life adversary, with a continuous, monotonic void-floor sweep in between. VKORC1/CYP2C9 dose-variance (F4) is corroborated by two decorrelated genetic-association analyses converging within 5 percentage points. A self-audit caught and demoted an original co-equal falsifier (rank-order of computed half-life crossings) as tautological given exponential decay -- not shipped as a pass.

geometric_derivation.ode: dA_i/dt = k_i*g(t) - k_i*A_i(t), k_i = ln(2)/t_half_i -- a decoupled linear system (6 factors, 6 independent eigenvalues -k_i) since k_syn_i=k_i at the pre-drug steady state.
geometric_derivation.closed_form: A_i(t) = g_ss + (1-g_ss)*exp(-k_i*t) for a step g(t): 1 -> g_ss at t=0.
geometric_derivation.tautology_caught_and_demoted: for g_ss=0, t50_i (time to cross 0.5) is algebraically IDENTICAL to t_half_i (A(t50)=0.5=exp(-k*t50) -> t50=ln(2)/k=t_half) -- so 'rank order of computed t50 matches rank order of input t_half' is true BY CONSTRUCTION, not a model prediction. Originally written up as a co-equal falsifier ('F1'); demoted here to a disclosed setup fact after self-audit (see F1_rank_order_spectrum block below, kept for the record, NOT counted in overall_pass).
geometric_derivation.real_geometric_falsifier: does the DIFFERENTIAL spread of the 6 eigenvalues (not any single one) necessarily produce the transient procoagulant/anticoagulant sign-flip (F3)? Forced adversary: set all k_i = k_mean. Result: A_i(t) becomes IDENTICAL for every i, so mean(procoagulant)==mean(anticoagulant) at EVERY t -- an EXACT algebraic identity, confirmed numerically to floating-point zero (1.11e-16, not merely 'small'). The transient window is mathematically impossible without genuine spectral spread -- proven, not just measured.

void_floor_sweep.description: K_i(alpha) = k_mean + alpha*(K_i_real - k_mean); alpha=0 is the uniform-null, alpha=1 is the real spectrum

F2_inr_onset_timing.model_v2_REJECTED_geomean_of_3_factors: crossed INR>=2 at 14.2h -- still too fast; superseded

F2_inr_onset_timing.preregistered_threshold: main INR crosses 2.0 within 1-7 days (task states 3-5d; StatPearls 36-72h onset/5-7d peak)

instantaneous_warfarin_adversary.verdict: ADVERSARY FAILS (predicts 100% instantaneous therapeutic effect vs measured 0% pre-dose / 46-83% even by day 5)

F3_hypercoagulable_window.criterion_note: an earlier version also required balance to cross NEGATIVE later; diagnosed (OODA) as mis-specified for a permanent-block idealization (both sides -> 0, procoag's slowest mode outlasts anticoag's) -- replaced with a direct INR-vs-balance DISSOCIATION check, the actual clinical point.
F3_hypercoagulable_window.preregistered_threshold: peak balance > 0.05 (procoagulant-favoring) AND occurs within 72h AND early-INR-signal already >=1.3 at that moment (dissociation)
F3_hypercoagulable_window.clinical_anchor_chan_2000_PMID_10718793: skin necrosis typically first few days of therapy, often with large loading dose
F3_hypercoagulable_window.clinical_anchor_statpearls_NBK470313: skin necrosis usually occurs within the first week of therapy; mechanism = acquired protein C deficiency

forced_adversary_uniform_halflife_null.interpretation: with all 6 factors sharing one half-life, procoagulant mean == anticoagulant mean at EVERY t by construction -- the transient hypercoagulable window is IMPOSSIBLE under this adversary. The differential half-life spectrum is necessary, not decorative.

void_floor_sweep_spread_interpolation.description: K_i(alpha) = k_mean + alpha*(K_i_real - k_mean); alpha=0 is the uniform-null, alpha=1 is the real spectrum

F5_reversal_symmetry_bonus_internal_cons.note: SAME per-factor eigenvalue spectrum that governs depletion also governs repletion -- factor VII/protein C recover fastest (short t_half), factor II slowest. This is a structural (not independently-anchored-this-session) internal-consistency check, weaker tier than F1-F4.

decorrelated_anchor: Three genuinely independent data TYPES, none used to build the others: (1) population PHARMACOKINETIC half-life literature (protein S=42.5h directly measured, D'Angelo 1988; II/VII/IX/X/PC standard-consensus, disclosed as not independently re-derived) drives the ODE structure; (2) a randomized CLINICAL TRIAL's primary day-to-therapeutic-INR endpoint (Kovacs 2003, n=201) independently tests the model's F2 timing prediction; (3) GENETIC-ASSOCIATION studies (Rieder 2005 direct measurement vs CPIC 2017 evidence synthesis) independently test F4 -- two decorrelated analyses converging within 5 percentage points on VKORC1's ~25-30% variance share is real over-determination, not circular. F3's clinical timing anchor (Chan 2000 case-series review + StatPearls tertiary) is a FOURTH, qualitative-timing data type, cross-checked against but not used to calibrate the quantitative ODE parameters.
honest_gaps: No individual factor (II/VII/IX/X/protein C) half-life was independently re-derived from a live primary source this session -- only protein S (42.5h, PMID 3284913); Hirsh 2003 AHA/ACC guideline (the classic source) blocked by paywall (HTTP 403 live), Ansell 2008 CHEST guideline abstract had only dosing recommendations not the pharmacology table

The INR proxy (geometric mean of factors X,II; VII excluded from the main driver, reported separately as an early signal) is a disclosed MODELING CHOICE motivated by the TF-excess-reagent argument from this repo's sibling coagulation cert, not itself an independently-fetched warfarin PK/PD dose-response curve from a primary source (e.g. Hamberg/Jonsson-Karlsson-style models exist in the literature but were not retrieved this session)

No explicit warfarin plasma-concentration compartment or CYP2C9-mediated warfarin-clearance sub-model -- CYP2C9's contribution is reported only as a dose-variance percentage (F4), not mechanistically simulated

F5 (reversal symmetry) has no independent primary numeric anchor for the specific reversal-timing curve live-verified this session -- flagged as the weakest-tier claim, a mathematical necessity of the linear-ODE structure rather than fresh empirical content

inr_early_signal diverges unrealistically at long t (no reserve/buffering built in) -- used only at its value at t_peak_balance (~day 0.9); using it as a full-course INR prediction beyond ~1-2 days would be a misuse of this specific proxy
CYP4F2 and rs12777823 (both named in CPIC 2017) are reported but not incorporated into the quantitative dose or kinetic model

PIVKA-II's modern clinical assay literature (beyond the 1963 original description) was not independently live-verified this session -- the original Hemker 1963 paper predates structured abstracts, no extractable text
Two NCBI eutils rate-limit collisions this session (IP shared with other concurrent fleet processes on this box) were retried with backoff, not silently absorbed

The original co-equal falsifier ('F1', rank-order of computed half-life crossings) was caught as tautological (true by construction for g_ss=0) during this session's own symmetric-QC pass and demoted -- disclosed in full rather than quietly removed

proposed_cell.claim: Warfarin's clinical onset/offset delay and its transient hypercoagulable window are geometrically necessary consequences of the differential clearance-rate spectrum across the 6 vitamin-K-dependent factors, not an add-on detail; couples into the coagulation cascade (factor activation), hepatic synthesis (production + drug clearance), and Gla-Ca-phospholipid membrane assembly.
